'''November 1999 Anderson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament at the Danger Room in Anderson, Indiana, on 13 November 1999.<ref name="cec-r3">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report3.html Anderson, In (11/13/99)], Thomas McManus, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030133/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report3.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Thomas McManus]] finished 3rd at 3–1. His opponents are named only as Carlos, Katie and Brian.

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' 13 November 1999
* '''Site:''' The Danger Room, Anderson, Indiana
* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
